name: al5809-60
description: Diodes AL5809-60P1-7 two-terminal 60 mA (±5%) constant-current LED regulator, 2.5-60 V across IN-OUT, PowerDI-123, 1.24 W on a good pad (LCSC C154921). Parallel several for more current; PWM 100-200 Hz via a low-side MOSFET on OUT (0.5 ms min on/off)

pins.name: IN
pins.description: current input (LED cathode side for low-side use)

current.description: regulated current (SPICE units), 57-63 mA for the -60 part

metadata.rotation_note: verified again in JLCPCB's placement preview on the mug order, 2026-09-08: band (OUT) on pad 2 with offset 180. JLCPCB's reel orientation is 180° from this footprint (their preview on the led-panel order, 2026-09-07, put the banded OUT end on the IN pad at offset 0). With offset 180 the CPL places the banded OUT end (pad 2, -x) and the unmarked IN end (pad 1, +x) where the footprint has them. Datasheet DS36625 p.13: bar = OUT.
